newsitem.title: USA: Cameron Ashley plans to acquire Bois Daigle.
newsitem.headline: Cameron Ashley plans to acquire Bois Daigle.

text.p: Cameron Ashley Building Products Inc said it had agreed to aquire Bois Daigle Ltee, a Canadian distributor of building materials headquartered in Boucherville, Quebec, from Simard-Beaudry Inc, a Quebec-based construction and building materials company.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

The transaction is subject to certain conditions including completion of the due diligence process and the approval of the directors of Cameron Ashley Building Products and Simard-Beaudry. It is expected to close on or about April 30, 1997.
Daigle reported 1996 revenues of approximately US$47 million (US).
